_comment: Drift map read by .claude/hooks/knowledge-drift.sh (PostToolUse) and .claude/skills/audit-docs/audit.sh. When an edited file_path matches `match` (regex), the hook nudges to re-check `doc`.

mappings.nudge: Data code changed: check docs/DATASETS.md still matches (sources, shapes, splits, variables, preprocessing) and that tests/test_data_splits.py metadata still applies.
Model/scheduler/callback/config surface changed: check CLAUDE.md conventions and README feature list still match, and that the guardrail tests cover the change.
Entrypoint or CI changed: check the README quickstart and CI section still match.
Eval outputs written: record the result as a one-line DONE entry in EXPERIMENTS.md (wandb link + conclusion) and clear the TODO row.
You wrote a memory. If this fact is shareable and non-secret, promote it to CLAUDE.md or a skill; keep secrets/IDs/personal notes in memory only.
